metadata.purpose: Sample a remembered latest source value on notifier next only.

conditions: Each output corresponds to one distinct source value observed since the preceding sampling event.
A sampling event without a pending value emits nothing. Intermediate overwritten values are dropped.
Source completes/errors immediately; pending values do not flush on source termination.

scope.parameters: One external Observable notifier, no scheduling or conversion of Promise inputs.
scope.callbacks: No user predicate or projection; notifier payloads are ignored.
scope.time: Time belongs to the source and notifier; the operator introduces no clock.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic post-setup notifications, no simultaneous/torn-down scheduler action execution.
exclusions: Synchronous notifier activity while initial source/notifier subscriptions are being constructed.
Non-Observable notifier inputs, source/observer reentrancy, throwing teardown and scheduler errors.

ownership.sharing: None; one independent memory and clock/notifier per result subscription.
ownership.reset: New subscription starts with hasValue=false and a new notifier or timer.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Value presence and clock generation are committed before downstream delivery. Tick resources are scheduler-owned.
cancellationCheckpoints: Before each notifier/timer notification and on consumer cancellation.

controls.description: cold description; no subscriptions or timers
live source and newest unsampled value, if any

rules.explanation: Sampling does nothing until a consumer subscribes. Subscription to the source precedes clock/notifier setup.
rules.nextState: Listening with no remembered value and one sampling mechanism.

actions: replace remembered value with exact payload; no downstream notification
rules.explanation: A new source value overwrites the previous value. No callbacks, timing or output occur on source.next.

actions: emit latest value once and clear presence
rules.explanation: Each notifier next releases the most recent unsampled value exactly once.
rules.nextState: Clear remembered presence on every sample.

rules.guard: notifier next with no value since last sample
rules.explanation: A notifier next without a new value does not duplicate old output.
rules.nextState: Clear remembered presence on every sample.

rules.guard: notifier is open; completion is not a sampling notification
actions: release notifier; do not flush latest value or terminate source
rules.explanation: The pinned sample operator supplies noop as its notifier completion handler.
rules.nextState: Source continues with notifier completed and unsampled memory retained.

rules.explanation: Notifier failure fails the result and prevents further source emissions.

actions: complete immediately, without flushing pending value
rules.explanation: Source completion is not a sampling tick. Unobserved last values are discarded.
Source errors terminate without flushing the pending value.

actions: release subscriptions or timer; never notify
rules.explanation: Cancellation ends source and sampling ownership silently.
